title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-02-28
lineage: Dat (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16/48; Edited & Mastered in Audacity by Joe Noel: Wave > Flac 16/48
source: flac16/48kHz; SBD > 2-track Master Reels > Dat; Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a magical late‑February 1969 show, highlighted by Pigpen’s swagger on “Lucy in the Sky” and a jam‑filled second set.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this recording as a must‑hear slice of early ’69 Dead, praising the vibrant first‑set energy (especially Pigpen’s swagger and a drenched “Lucy in the Sky”) and the exploratory jamming of the second set that even lands on a powerful “Death Don't…”. The soundboard source delivers crystal‑clear audio with no noted flaws, making it an ideal listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews consistently praise both the performance and the audio quality; the show is described as magical with standout moments, and the soundboard source is implied to be excellent.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the listen as 'great' and 'magical' with no complaints about clarity or mix, indicating a pristine soundboard capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set praised for Pigpen’s swagger and strong vocal delivery; second set noted for extended jamming and a seamless flow into darker material.
